capabilities: Change the case of selected text (lowercase, uppercase, title case, camelCase, slugify)
Clean up pasted or OCR text by removing redundant spaces, line breaks, hyphens, and ligatures
Convert Markdown constructs such as bullet lists, ordered lists, and WikiLinks/URL links
Run custom regex replacements, wrappers, and API requests on selections
Prepare academic text with Zotero paste, Anki card format, citation removal, and LaTeX conversion
extras: README is bilingual (Chinese/English), includes a privacy section stating no telemetry is collected, and documents the Format on paste feature as experimental. Many commands link to GitHub issues for discussion instead of being fully documented in the README.
motivation: The author built it after repeatedly hitting badly formatted text when copying content from PDFs and other sources into notes, needing case conversion and space/line-break cleanup.
problem: Text copied from PDFs, OCR, or other sources often arrives with broken lines, extra spaces, and wrong casing that Obsidian gives no built-in commands to fix.

relations.evidence: Get Zotero note from clipboard and paste
Convert selection into Anki card format
Convert a LaTeX array generated by Mathpix to Markdown table format
With bib-cacher, I can connect to Zotero database by python

summary: Command-based text transformer that changes case, cleans up pasted/OCR text, and converts Markdown lists, links, and notation in selections.
